atomic_facts.fact: Martin Shkreli was convicted of securities fraud and conspiracy in the Eastern District of New York (a felony).
As of mid-2026 the conviction remains on record: Shkreli is still described as having a criminal history and the conviction has not been vacated.
No pardon had been granted as of the report date; Shkreli had only formally requested one.
Martin Shkreli formally requested a pardon from the White House.
As of 2026-10-01 the pardon had not been granted (he had not been pardoned).
A U.S. District Judge ordered Martin Shkreli to return $64.6 million in profits from the Daraprim price hike.
That order constitutes an adverse civil judgment (court-ordered remedy) against Shkreli.
Martin Shkreli is known by the alias/moniker 'Pharma Bro'.
